tasks.label: dev
args: set -e && docker compose up -d postgres localstack && until docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U postgres -d next_effect >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && POSTGRES_HOST=$(docker compose exec -T postgres hostname -i | tr -d '') && LOCALSTACK_HOST=$(docker compose exec -T localstack hostname -i | tr -d '') && export DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@${POSTGRES_HOST}:5432/next_effect && export AWS_REGION=us-east-1 && export AWS_ENDPOINT_URL=http://${LOCALSTACK_HOST}:4566 && export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test && export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test && export BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000 && export NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 && pnpm dev
